overall_summary: Performance analysis of deduplicated recent uploads reveals a strong audience preference for extreme hypothetical space scenarios ("What If") and cosmic anomalies featuring high-value, tangible imagery (planets of burning ice, liquid diamond worlds, dark/coal planets, and astronomical anomalies like Venus's solar day). Videos utilizing high-stakes hypothetical outcomes combined with striking planetary/cosmic phenomena achieve significantly higher views-per-day and engagement rates (likes-per-view) compared to micro-biology, standard psychological tricks, or basic historical facts in this dataset.

winning_patterns.pattern: Hypothetical Space Extremes ('What If you fell into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) lead in views (1,024 and 972) and robust engagement (38 and 18 likes) within a short post-publication window.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on 'What If' scenarios applied to newly discovered or extreme theoretical cosmic bodies.

winning_patterns.evidence: The Planet Darker Than Coal (v1rrcZLdp4U) with 1,027 views and Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year (A9Qa-RmuOr0) with 980 views show high velocity for counter-intuitive planetary physics.
winning_patterns.action: Structure hooks around paradoxical planetary facts that defy everyday intuition about time, light, or matter.

weak_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, r43-7nSn8SQ) flatlined with 5 to 10 views and zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone human psychology shorts unless tied directly to a high-concept sensory or survival thriller narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts like 'The Only Animal That Can Live Forever' (F1kXwuXuNgo) or basic trivia logged minimal traction compared to cosmic scale videos.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid standard listicle-style trivia; ensure every fact utilizes vast visual scales or extreme danger hooks.
